prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity, shippable desktop ABOUT PAGE first viewport for a public developer portfolio, exactly 1536×1024 landscape, straight-on full-bleed website screenshot with no browser chrome or device frame.
Input images: Image 1 is a pixel reference for the established “Activity Ledger” visual system only. Preserve its visual DNA, navbar/footer chrome, materials, typography character, linework, spacing discipline, and square component language. Do not copy its homepage content, hero composition, financial app artwork, GitHub activity, project names, or homepage sections.
Primary request: Create a distinct About page direction titled “The Working Dossier” for a developer working in investment banking and building software to investigate technical questions. It must read as a real production website UI, not a poster. The ABOUT navigation item is the active page.
Scene/backdrop: light warm recycled paper with subtle horizontal ruled-paper texture, faint imperfections, cobalt-blue hairline grid and section rules, a single restrained red margin rule, layered dossier-paper edges where appropriate.
Subject and layout: Reuse the reference’s slim full-width top navigation chrome: “Marc Mansour” at left in editorial serif, then “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACT”, “BLOG” in compact uppercase mono, with a short red underline under “ABOUT”; preserve the narrow book/page folio detail at far right. Below, create a clearly different About-page layout. Top-left: a small mono file label “ABOUT / THE WORKING DOSSIER”, followed by one giant decisive editorial-serif opening statement occupying about two-thirds width. Top-right: a compact square-edged current-position record rendered like a clipped dossier index slip, labeled “CURRENT POSITION” and “INVESTMENT BANKING”, with restrained blue rules and one tiny lime proof tab. Beneath the opening, place the supplied explanatory paragraph as readable body copy. The next band is a system of four overlapping or side-by-side dossier leaves/tabs, each square-edged and individually legible, numbered in mono: “01 / INVESTMENT BANKING”, “02 / TECHNICAL PRESSURE”, “03 / SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT”, “04 / PUBLIC WORK”. Make their treatment feel like working papers, index tabs, case-file dividers, or annotated ledger leaves—not generic cards. Use sparse handwritten-style marginal proof notes or red pencil circles without adding factual claims. Show enough of this deeper dossier band to establish how the page continues below the first fold. At the end of the visible page, include a strong square cobalt CTA “START A CONVERSATION” and a secondary outlined action “OPEN RÉSUMÉ”, then a compact ruled footer chrome matching the reference with the name and simple navigation/contact structure, no handles or URLs.
Style/medium: refined editorial web interface screenshot, Activity Ledger visual world, Bitter-like high-contrast editorial display serif, Open Sans-like highly readable body sans, Source Code Pro-like compact mono labels. Crisp vector-like UI rendering, careful baseline grid, asymmetric editorial composition, square corners, no gloss.
Composition/framing: exactly 1536×1024. Header about 72px high. Giant statement and current-position record dominate the upper 430px. Explanatory paragraph bridges into the four dossier leaves across the middle. CTA strip and compact footer remain visible near the bottom edge. Use a mature desktop grid and generous negative space while keeping all required content legible.
Lighting/mood: flat archival daylight, rigorous, thoughtful, technically credible, candid rather than promotional.
Color palette: warm paper off-white, dark ink charcoal/navy, cobalt blue rules and primary CTA, very sparse acid-lime verification accents and red pencil proof marks. WCAG-conscious text contrast.
Materials/textures: subtle recycled paper fibers, faint ruled lines, thin cobalt drafting grid, physical clipped-paper cues, crisp ink, square/no-gloss components.
Text (verbatim): Giant statement: “I work in investment banking, where technical questions are part of the job.” Body paragraph: “Software became how I investigate them and build better answers.” Current record labels: “CURRENT POSITION” and “INVESTMENT BANKING”. Dossier labels: “01 / INVESTMENT BANKING”, “02 / TECHNICAL PRESSURE”, “03 / SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT”, “04 / PUBLIC WORK”. Actions: “START A CONVERSATION” and “OPEN RÉSUMÉ”.
Constraints: Render all specified text correctly, horizontally, sharply, and legibly. This is an About page, not a homepage and not a marketing poster. Preserve visual continuity with Image 1 while creating a new page structure. No employer, job title, dates, metrics, client names, testimonials, product names, project names, company logos, fabricated outcomes, social handles, URLs, or numerical performance claims. Any tiny supporting marks must be abstract editorial notation rather than invented facts. Keep the navigation and footer usable and conventional. Realistic product UI with WCAG-conscious contrast.
Avoid: copying homepage content; financial charts; GitHub contribution grids; homepage hero layout; rounded generic cards; pill-heavy UI; gradients; glassmorphism; shadows that look glossy; photorealistic desk scenes; people; devices; browser chrome; decorative 3D; fake data; watermarks; illegible pseudo-text; repeated or misspelled required text.
postprocess: Removed one unsupported generated location value using a cloned blank paper patch, then converted to WebP.
